name: Robotics startup Generalist reaches $3B valuation, sources say
description: The $200 million extension comes just months after the physical AI startup reached a $2 billion valuation.

name: OpenAI loses a top data center exec, as stream of high-profile departures continues
description: Before Malone left, OpenAI had already reshuffled its infrastructure org, shifting his reporting line away from President Greg Brockman and putting Vice President Sachin Katti in charge of the group.

name: Stability AI, maker of image generator Stable Diffusion, raises $76 million in fresh funding
description: The company's new fundraising total now stands at $232 million.

name: Claude Cowork finally remembers what you told the app in chat
description: Anthropic is giving Claude a shared memory across chat and Cowork, so users no longer have to repeatedly brief the AI on projects, preferences, and other context.

name: Gamma acquires Accel-backed design startup Lica
description: Lica co-founders are going to work on Gamma's new research team.

name: OpenAI’s Jalapeño chip is built for fast inference at scale, benchmarks show
description: Tested on SemiAnalysis’ InferenceX benchmark, Jalapeño registered both more tokens per user and more throughput per kilowatt than the currently available state-of-the art.

name: Accel-backed Keenable is indexing the web for AI agents
description: Now exiting stealth mode with a $26 million seed round, Keenable has been building a vast web search index for AI agents.

name: ‘The world seems to be ready’: An interview with OpenAI head of product Thibault Sottiaux
description: TechCrunch talks agents, UX, and reporting to Greg Brockman with OpenAI's head of product.

name: Situational Awareness, star AI hedge fund that nearly imploded, now being probed by the SEC
description: The AI hedge fund went from "the talk of Wall Street" to "subject of federal subpoenas" faster than you can say "diversify your portfolio."

name: Trump bought SpaceX shares two weeks after blockbuster IPO
description: The president bought when the stock was in the mid-$150 range. SpaceX finished trading on Monday back at its IPO price of $135.

name: Amjad Masad, CEO and co-founder of Replit, joins the Disrupt Stage at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
description: At TechCrunch Disrupt 2026, Replit CEO Amjad Masad will share his perspective on the future of programming and Replit's role in developing it.

name: Instinct’s powerful AI assistant is raising privacy and security concerns
description: Early testers are raving about what Instinct can do, but some say the AI assistant’s sweeping access, broad terms and ability to act on users’ behalf come with uncomfortable trade-offs.

name: Valor, Point72 back General Intuition at $6B valuation as AI startup pushes into robotics
description: General Intuition, the startup building a foundation model that trains generalized AI agents how to move through space and time, is in talks to raise at a $6 billion pre-money valuation from new investors including Valor Ventures, Point72 Ventures, and Seven Seven Six.

name: OpenAI is building AI agents for everything. Will everyone use them?
description: Inside the frontier lab’s push to bring AI agents from software engineers to the masses.

name: Hugging Face reportedly in talks to be acquired for $13B
description: Hugging Face has reportedly been fielding acquisition offers that would value the company at around $13B. But with the founders' feeling of responsibility to community, doubts arise as to whether a sale will happen.

name: Who’s behind the new ‘stealth model’ Ox Alpha?
description: A mysterious new AI model called Ox Alpha has driven certain corners of the internet into a frenzy of speculation.

name: Linkdaze’s smart calendar is built to run a household, not just track a schedule
description: Linkdaze's smart digital calendar stands out for not putting its features behind a paywall, including an AI meal planner tool.

name: Flock CEO calls for ‘compromise’ as surveillance company faces growing backlash
description: Flock Safety faces a growing public outcry over concerns that its surveillance technology could be misused.

name: Is it legal to train AI models on copyrighted books? It’s complicated
description: Most published authors have, without their knowledge or consent, contributed to the development of the same AI tools that threaten to undermine their livelihoods. That seems illegal, right?

name: Harvard’s $699 startup bootcamp offers AI avatars of its instructors
description: In the HBS Foundry program, AI avatars provide feedback during practice pitches and board meetings.
